snippet.title: ♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.1 Outfit Preview: Forest Ripple
snippet.description:
♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.1 Outfit Preview: Forest Ripple

Fireflies rise and scatter, dissolving into drifting motes of light among the trees.
Through seasons of solitude, the fragile, timeless poem of growth
finds its verses in withered leaves and twilight's whispers.

Main Attribute: Fresh
Outfit Ability: [Flourish Walk]
After using the [Flourish Walk] ability, Nikki can resonate with plants around her, allowing her to gather all the plants within the range of the ability at once. This is also applicable in Home. When this ability is used, she can also make the collected plants within range re-mature. The same collectible plant can only re-mature once per day. This isn't applicable in Home. After triggering the re-maturing of plants, illusory flowers will bloom wherever Nikki walks.
Evolve the outfit to Stage 3 to unlock [Memory Ripple: Makeup], enhanced special effects, a new idle animation, and alternative details for certain pieces.

Decoration: Dreamy Vines
Can be placed in open spaces. At midnight, the vines never sleep, hanging down a thousand fragrant dreams for passing butterflies to pause and admire.
◆ Available after reaching 160 Resonances in the limited-time Resonance [Unwithering Poems]

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.1 Life as a Poem launches globally on January 6 (UTC-7)!
